title: 有馬記念の後に・“1番”のウマ娘！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet conquers the Arima Kinen to earth-shattering applause.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears flow as she stands in the Winner's Circle and basks in the crowd's adoration. She heads to the awards ceremony with a bright smile on her face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her name engraved on the hearts of all who watched her race, she has truly become the number one Umamusume.
